description.en: EIBench is a simulator-based benchmark for interactive emotion management, containing 2,222 scenarios across a 2x2 taxonomy of Support, Defense, Repair, and Charm. It evaluates LLM agents on multi-turn dialogue where a user simulator updates emotion-relation states and provides anchor-based scoring.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: EIBench fills the gap in evaluating emotional intelligence beyond static understanding, focusing on interactive emotion management over multiple turns. Its simulator provides both outcome and dense turn-level feedback, enabling training and evaluation in a unified environment.
